property_summary: For any callers and any _feeRate input within allowed bounds, calling initialize(...) sets the contract's public feeRate to the provided _feeRate; the mutant sets feeRate to 0 instead, so there exist inputs where c.feeRate() != _feeRate after initialize.
change_summary: Set feeRate to zero instead of the provided _feeRate (replace assignment feeRate = _feeRate; with feeRate = 0;).
